name: LinkedIn Scraper
description: LinkedIn scraper for Python and the command line: public profiles, company pages and job listings for a role and location, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no LinkedIn login, proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: profiles
commands.help: public LinkedIn profiles by slug or /in/ URL
commands.description: Public LinkedIn profile preview — name, headline, company, location.

inputs.name: profiles
inputs.description: Profile slugs (williamhgates) or /in/ URLs, one per line.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many profiles to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered profiles.

commands.name: companies
commands.help: public LinkedIn company pages by slug or /company/ URL
commands.description: Public LinkedIn company page — employees, followers, industry, HQ.

inputs.name: companies
inputs.description: Company slugs (microsoft) or /company/ URLs, one per line.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many companies to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered companies.

commands.name: jobs
commands.help: public LinkedIn job listings for a role and location
commands.description: Public LinkedIn job listings for a role and location.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "data engineer".

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City, region or country, e.g. "New York" or "Italy".

inputs.name: remote_only
inputs.description: Only listings LinkedIn marks as remote.

inputs.name: posted_within_days
inputs.description: Only listings posted in the last N days (1–30).

inputs.name: include_details
inputs.description: Also read each job's public posting: full description, seniority level, employment type, job function, industries and applicant count. One extra request per job, so runs take longer; off by default.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many jobs to deliver at most (1–300). You pay only for delivered jobs.
